stories.title: Study: Gen Z is using AI, but skepticism grows
stories.simple_summary: Young people are using AI tools, but many don't fully trust them yet.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work with younger employees or customers, knowing they use AI but question it might help you understand how they approach technology.

stories.title: OpenAI fires workers for mishandling 'sensitive information'
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI fired some workers because they weren't careful with confidential company information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and employees of tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI liability fight reaches Senate as Google releases powerful new model
stories.simple_summary: Lawmakers in Congress are debating who should be responsible when AI causes damage, and Google released a new powerful AI tool.
stories.why_it_matters: This is early-stage legal discussion that mostly affects tech companies right now — nothing you need to act on yet.

stories.title: Musk’s AI chatbot Grok reportedly encouraged Trump to capture  Venezuela’s president
stories.simple_summary: Reports say Elon Musk's AI chatbot Grok supposedly gave advice to Trump about military action in Venezuela.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about political news involving AI — unless you work in government or politics, it doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Google’s new Guided Vision feature can help you read the fine print
stories.simple_summary: Google added a feature to its AI that can read small print out loud to you by pointing your phone's camera at it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have trouble reading small text on labels or signs, this Google feature could be genuinely helpful for you.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT now lets you take a photo of yourself and see how clothes would look on you before buying them online.
stories.why_it_matters: If you shop online, this could save you returns — you could see if a shirt or jacket actually fits you before ordering.

stories.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,800 times before space data centers get off the ground
stories.simple_summary: Google is building data centers (computer servers that store information) in space and estimates it would need thousands of launches to make this work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical engineering project that mostly matters to investors and tech engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI fired three safety researchers for mishandling sensitive company secrets.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people tracking tech company management — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)
stories.simple_summary: A company's new AI writing model has recognizable patterns in how it writes, like using certain words too often.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly interests AI engineers and people studying how to spot AI-written text — not relevant for everyday use.

stories.title: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews
stories.simple_summary: A judge dismissed lawsuits against Google claiming its AI search results unfairly took traffic away from other websites.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to website owners and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web
stories.simple_summary: Amazon released a new AI tool that helps make decisions, joining other companies releasing similar tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to businesses using Amazon's cloud services — nothing you need to act on unless you use AWS.

stories.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
stories.simple_summary: Shopify released a new tool where you can chat with an AI to build and design your online store and watch the changes happen in real time.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small business and want to create an online store, this could make it much easier and faster without needing to hire a web designer.
